name: Nangoku Sodachi Mahjong in Erromango
original_name: 南国素勃ち麻雀 in イロマンゴ
source:
You're on a tropical island full of beautiful ladies, and they all have giant dicks!

If you want to get with them you have to beat them at mahjong! Or not, they're always up for fun whether you win or lose!
translation:
你在一个充满美丽女士的热带岛屿上，而且她们都有巨大的鸡鸡！

如果你想和他们在一起，你就必须在麻将中打败他们！不管你输赢，他们总是乐在其中！
